claims: The 2025 Samsung S90F is a 4K QD-OLED smart TV.
The 2025 Samsung S90F features the NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor.
The 2025 Samsung S90F utilizes QD-OLED technology.
The NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor handles 4K AI Upscaling Pro.
The 2025 Samsung S90F optimizes picture and sound via Samsung Vision AI.
The 2025 Samsung S90F supports 144Hz refresh rate with Motion Xcelerator.
The 2025 Samsung S90F runs on Tizen OS.
The 2025 Samsung S90F is available in 42, 48, 55, 65, 77, and 83 inches.
The 2025 Samsung S90F does not support Dolby Vision.
The 65-inch model of the 2025 Samsung S90F is currently priced at $1,298.
The 65-inch model of the 2025 Samsung S90F is down from $1,698.
The 65-inch model of the 2025 Samsung S90F has a 24% discount to $1,298.
Pricing and stock availability for the 2025 Samsung S90F are based on reports from April 17, 2026.
A 59-second YouTube video by The Megawatts from December 8, 2025 provides a first-hand look at the 2025 Samsung S90F's design and features.
